generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26, Satisfactorily completed (at least 50% of the contract value i.e 6.50 Lakhs), as prime contractor, at least any similar work of Generator Supply

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26, Achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 13.00 lakhs (usually not less than the estimated cost under this contract and Turnover certificate from CA with valid UDIN No. to be furnished along with necessary documents)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: Each tenderer should further demonstrate, Liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 3.90 lakhs (Credit lines/letter of credit/certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc.) (usually 30% of the amount of contract) in the format given in the bid document
Bidder should be minimum Class III P.W.D registered Civil contractor

Bidder should furnish site inspection report(The site inspection condition has been incorporated in public interest to enable the bidders to understand in advance the nature of the work, local site conditions, access arrangements, availability of water/electricity, and the technical challenges involved in execution of the work. This condition is uniformly applicable to all tenderers)

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover certificate audited by CA and mentioning UDIN No
Line of credit/Bankers certificate and Conditional LOC certificates not accepted

Supplying, installing, testing and commissioning of Diesel Generator set with following specifications. Power rating as per standard reference condition as per- BS 5514/ISO 3046/ISO 8528 & IS 1002/ISO 3046 Generator set specifications.
Engine: Diesel generating set are rated at 1500 RPM and conform to ISO 8528 specifications. Capacity of Fuel Tank: Fuel tank suitable for 8hours of operation. Use of special hardware for longer life, Insulation material meets exacting IS 8183 specifications for better sound attenuation, Flush styling-no projections, Fluid drains for lubeoil and fuel,Fuel filling point in side the enclosure.The complete set shall have sufficient safety and adhere to NEC,NBC 2016, IEC,CPWD specifications,PCB norms and KSGEI Acts and Rules. Complete 100KVA/80kw
